sloka: इहाहं यदि तिष्ठामि स्वेन रूपेण संवृतः ।विनाशमुपयास्यामि भर्तुरर्थश्च हीयते ॥५-२-४५॥
transliteration: ihāhaṁ yadi tiṣṭhāmi svena rūpeṇa saṁvṛtaḥ ।vināśamupayāsyāmi bharturarthaśca hīyate ॥5-2-45॥

translations.english: 'I will surely meet with death if I hide here in my original form and my master's mission also will be spoilt.
